description: This is a Java test source file for the HttpPushClientActor class, part of the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests for the HTTP push client actor, testing connection handling, TLS, message publishing, and placeholder replacement.

classes.name: HttpPushClientActorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the HttpPushClientActor, testing connection, message publishing, and error scenarios.

methods.name: createActorSystem
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem and local HTTP server for testing.

methods.name: stopActorSystem
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after tests.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Provides a Connection object configured for either HTTP or HTTPS.

methods.name: createClientActor
methods.description: Creates Props for the HttpPushClientActor with given connection.

methods.name: connectAndDisconnect
methods.description: Test actor connection open and close functionality.

methods.name: testTCPConnectionFails
methods.description: Tests behavior when TCP connection fails.

methods.name: testTLSConnectionFails
methods.description: Tests behavior when TLS connection fails due to invalid certificates.

methods.name: testTLSConnection
methods.description: Tests successful TLS connection with self-signed certificates.

methods.name: publishTwinEvent
methods.description: Verifies that a twin event message results in the correct HTTP POST request, headers, and payload.

methods.name: placeholderReplacement
methods.description: Checks that placeholder URLs in targets are correctly replaced in the outgoing request path.

methods.name: toJsonString
methods.description: Utility method to serialize an adaptable object into JSON string for message payload.
